Read a {plater} Formatted Metadata File

Source: R/plate_metadata.R
plate_read_meta.Rd

Read a {plater} Formatted Metadata File

Usage

plate_read_meta(file, sep = ",", plate = NULL)

Arguments

file

File path to a {plater} formatted .csv file which contains metadata information.

sep

The separator for the .csv file, defaults to ",".

plate

The size of the plate, such as 96 or 384, or its number of rows and columns. If NULL, the smallest standard plate that holds all the wells is used.

Value

a tibble::tibble(). The well column holds well() IDs that know the size of the plate.

Examples


file_meta <- system.file(
  "extdata",
  "20220929_1steptimer20_metainfo.csv",
  package = "wellr"
)

plate_read_meta(file_meta)
